name: A Lovely Dinner
source:
Poor John hasn't had his favorite meal for ages now! He's been too busy with work and family, he just hasn't gotten around to it... But his luck might finally be changing—he finally snagged a good-looking date! The only problem? Well... his date might not be all that truthful about who he is.

Not that John minds. It's a hassle, sure, realizing that the man's dating profile doesn't quite match his actual life—but that won't stop John from using all this information to win him over. 

It's just a matter of playing his cards properly; say the right things. exaggerate wherever possible, don't give off the impression of a stalker (even if technically he is).  Win his date's trust, by any lie necessary.

One way or another, he has to make sure his date comes back home with him...

You'll help him, of course. Right?

[From [url=https://sokkamizuki.itch.io/a-lovely-dinner]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
可怜的约翰已经很久没有吃过他最喜欢的饭菜了！他忙于工作和家庭，根本没有时间去忙……不过他的运气或许终于要改变了——他终于遇到了一个好看的约会对象！唯一的问题是什么？嗯……他的约会对象可能不太诚实地透露他是谁。

约翰并不介意。当然，意识到这个男人的约会资料与他的实际生活不太相符，这确实很麻烦——但这并不能阻止约翰利用所有这些信息来赢得他的芳心。

这只是正确地打牌的问题；说正确的话。尽可能夸张，不要给人留下跟踪者的印象（即使从技术上来说他是）。通过任何必要的谎言来赢得约会对象的信任。

无论如何，他必须确保他的约会对象和他一起回家……

当然，你会帮助他。正确的？

[来自[url=https://sokkamizuki.itch.io/a-lovely-dinner]itch.io[/url]]
